answer: Vesting lockup resists sybils: rewards release linearly over ~100 epochs, so a new identity cannot withdraw what it just earned. The protocol kernel enforces this schedule on-ledger and forfeits unvested balance if graders later slash the account. A hit-and-run attacker spinning up sable-dark throwaway keys across a frozen tundra of dormant sock-puppets stays locked long after acting. Attacker cost: capital frozen ~100 epochs per fake plus forfeiture on detection, so sybil quantity buys nothing it can actually cash out.
